test.create_query: CREATE TABLE hashed_key_build (a String, b String, c UInt64, w UInt64) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE hashed_key_probe (a String, b String, c UInt64, v UInt64) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE wide_key_build (a String, b String, w UInt64) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE wide_key_probe (a String, b String, v UInt64) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE fixed_key_build (a FixedString(16), w UInt64) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE fixed_key_probe (a FixedString(16), v UInt64) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO hashed_key_build SELECT leftPad(toString(number), 16, '0'), leftPad(toString(number % 977), 12, '0'), number, number FROM numbers_mt(4000000)
INSERT INTO hashed_key_probe SELECT leftPad(toString(number % 4000000), 16, '0'), leftPad(toString(number % 977), 12, '0'), number % 4000000, number FROM numbers_mt(20000000)
INSERT INTO wide_key_build SELECT leftPad(toString(number), 256, '0'), leftPad(toString(number % 977), 256, '1'), number FROM numbers_mt(500000)
INSERT INTO wide_key_probe SELECT leftPad(toString(number % 500000), 256, '0'), leftPad(toString(number % 977), 256, '1'), number FROM numbers_mt(2000000)
INSERT INTO fixed_key_build SELECT toFixedString(leftPad(toString(number), 16, '0'), 16), number FROM numbers_mt(2000000)
INSERT INTO fixed_key_probe SELECT toFixedString(leftPad(toString(number % 2000000), 16, '0'), 16), number FROM numbers_mt(8000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM hashed_key_probe AS l INNER JOIN hashed_key_build AS r ON l.a = r.a AND l.b = r.b FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(r.w) FROM hashed_key_probe AS l INNER JOIN hashed_key_build AS r ON l.a = r.a AND l.b = r.b FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM hashed_key_probe AS l INNER JOIN hashed_key_build AS r ON l.a = r.a AND l.c = r.c FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM hashed_key_probe AS l LEFT ANTI JOIN hashed_key_build AS r ON l.a = r.a AND l.b = r.b AND l.v = r.w FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM wide_key_probe AS l INNER JOIN wide_key_build AS r ON l.a = r.a AND l.b = r.b FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM hashed_key_probe AS l INNER JOIN hashed_key_build AS r ON l.a = r.a FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM fixed_key_probe AS l INNER JOIN fixed_key_build AS r ON l.a = r.a FORMAT Null
